Our Mission

Preserving the Heritage of Telugu Christian Hymns

Andhra Kraistava Keerthanalu is dedicated to preserving, documenting, and sharing the rich legacy of Telugu Christian hymnody. Our goal is to make these timeless songs, their authors, historical context, books, interviews, and recordings accessible to believers around the world.

We believe these hymns are more than music—they are a testimony of faith, worship, and the spiritual heritage of Telugu-speaking Christians across generations.

About Andhra Kraistava Keerthanalu

Andhra Kraistava Keerthanalu represents a precious collection of Christian hymns composed in Telugu, the language of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. These hymns are not merely songs; they are expressions of faith, devotion, and cultural identity that have been passed down through generations.

This website serves as a digital sanctuary dedicated to preserving, understanding, and sharing these beautiful hymns. Here, you can explore the lives of hymn authors, discover the profound meanings behind their compositions, and listen to these timeless melodies that continue to inspire and uplift hearts across the world.

Cultural and Spiritual Significance

These hymns hold a special place in the hearts of Telugu-speaking Christians worldwide. They bridge the gap between ancient Christian traditions and local cultural expressions, creating a unique spiritual language that resonates with the Telugu community.

Each hymn tells a story—of faith tested, of hope renewed, of love divine. They serve as a source of comfort in times of sorrow, inspiration in moments of doubt, and celebration in seasons of joy. By preserving these hymns, we honor the legacy of faith passed down through generations and ensure that future generations can continue to draw strength and inspiration from these timeless treasures.
